description: Trafic routier tous véhicules et pourcentage poids lourds, par tronçon et par année is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by metadata.carmencarto.fr. All-vehicle road traffic and percentage of heavy goods vehicles, by section and year (1999 to 2015). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "All-vehicle road traffic and percentage of heavy goods vehicles, by section and year" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2018-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
